pool.text: A ball is thrown upward from ground level. Its height \( h \) in meters after \( t \) seconds is \( h(t) = -5t^2 + 30t \). For how many seconds is the ball at or above a height of 40 meters?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Set \( -5t^2 + 30t \geq 40 \implies -5t^2 + 30t - 40 \geq 0 \). Divide by \( -5 \): \( t^2 - 6t + 8 \leq 0 \implies (t - 2)(t - 4) \leq 0 \). The ball is at or above 40 meters for \( 2 \leq t \leq 4 \), which is a duration of \( 4 - 2 = 2 \) seconds.
hints: Set \( -5t^2 + 30t \geq 40 \implies -5t^2 + 30t - 40 \geq 0 \).
Divide by \( -5 \): \( t^2 - 6t + 8 \leq 0 \implies (t - 2)(t - 4) \leq 0 \).
The ball is at or above 40 meters for \(2 \leq t \leq 4\), which is a duration of \(4 - 2\) seconds.
